$description: Canonical, machine-readable asset-role vocabulary and reuse/replacement policy, centralizing the allowed role set already declared in each section contract's own assetRoles block. This file does NOT replace those per-section blocks -- their detailed, section-specific licensing prose (real names, exact counts, exact companies) stays exactly where it is; this file is the closed enum + generation-policy layer a generator/RAG pipeline checks against globally. extraction/verify_all.py's asset-role-closure check cross-references every role used in sections/*.json against this file, both directions.
sourceProjectNote: Granola is a real, live company. Real customer logos, real named-person testimonials/photos, real employee photos, and one real live third-party form embed (Tally) appear in this design-repo as real extracted evidence of structure, never as content a generator may reuse for a different brand.

generationPolicyValues.must-not-fabricate: Real, identifiable content (a real person, a real company, a real quote). A generator may follow the section's STRUCTURE but must never invent a fake instance attributed as real, and must never carry Granola's real instance into a different brand's generated page.
generationPolicyValues.must-reuse-exact: Granola's own real brand asset (its logo, its wordmark, its own UI icons). Reuse pixel-exact when generating Granola's own pages; never reuse for a different brand.
generationPolicyValues.may-generate-new: Generic, non-identifying imagery (abstract art, stock-style lifestyle photos, illustrative textures, generic product-UI mockups). Safe to regenerate a similar variant for any brand.
generationPolicyValues.must-not-reuse-live-endpoint: A real, live third-party integration (e.g. an embedded form). A generator must swap in the generated brand's own real endpoint; must never point a new page at Granola's live third-party endpoint.

real-person-photo.description: A real, named individual's real photo used as social proof (testimonial portrait, video-call clip).

real-company-logo.description: A real company's real trademarked logo (customer, integration partner, or investor mark).

real-person-quote.description: A real person's real quote/tweet attributed to their real handle.

team-photo.description: A real, named Granola team member's real photo.

ui-icon-exact.description: Granola's own UI iconography reused verbatim inside product-demo media.

product-demo-media.description: Real named people's real video-call clips used as product-demo B-roll -- likenesses, not just generic stock footage.

abstract-illustration.description: Illustrative/collage art not depicting real people or trademarks.

abstract-background-photo.description: Generic background photography, not real people/trademarks.

product-ui-screenshot.description: Abstract product/UI imagery, not real people or third-party trademarks.

editorial-photo.description: Generic editorial/cover imagery for blog content.

lifestyle-photo-set.description: Generic abstract/lifestyle imagery not depicting real identifiable people.

third-party-form-embed.description: A real, live third-party form widget (Tally) embedded for lead capture. A generator reusing this section's structure for a different brand must point it at that brand's own real form endpoint -- never submit to Granola's live Tally form.
